speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing difficulty conceiving and discomfort during sexual activity; to help you, I need to know if this pain occurs specifically with deep penetration and if you have noticed any changes in your menstrual cycles.

speaker: Patient
text: 30-year-old female. The patient and her husband have been trying to conceive for 15 months without success. They are sexually active at least twice a week. The husband occasionally has difficulties maintaining an erection. The patient reports discomfort and pelvic floor muscle tension during attempted vaginal penetration. Diagnosed with body dysmorphic disorder three years ago. No family history of serious illness. She is a non-smoker and does not drink alcohol. No medications.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Dyspareunia secondary to Pelvic Floor Dysfunction and Vulvodynia (likely provoked vestibulodynia), with concurrent infertility workup indicated given the 15-month duration of trying to conceive.

Please confirm if the pain is localized to the vaginal opening or deep within the pelvis, and have you experienced any prior surgeries or trauma to the pelvic region? REQUEST TEST: Pelvic_Exam; REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis.
